Kashmiri Pandit Group Reports Online Terror Threat, Seeks Investigation

The Kashmiri Pandit group Panun Kashmir reported an online terror threat issued by the United Liberation Council. The group stated the threat specifically named members of the Kashmiri Pandit community and disclosed their telephone numbers. Panun Kashmir has requested an investigation into the matter. CPI(M) leader M.Y. Tarigami condemned the threats and called for a united stand against intimidation.
